newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March BTP LIFFE future falls 200 bps.
newsitem.headline: Italy March BTP LIFFE future falls 200 bps.

text.p: The Italian March Btp future on LIFFE fell more than 200 basis points in late trade on Friday to the day's low of 127.50.
The spread of the benchmark November 2006 Btp over the benchmark Bund yawned to 198 basis points.
The March future was at its lowest level since January 7 this year.
Italian debt and currency markets have been suffering from investor concerns about the propects for Europe's planned economic and monetary union.
Earlier the lira fell to its lowest level against the mark for three months at 1,001.50 despite intervention to shore it up by the Bank of Italy, dealers said.
